How to Set Up Payment Gateways

Brilliant Directories supports multiple payment gateways including Stripe, PayPal Standard, and Authorize.net.

Supported Payment Gateways

To connect Stripe, navigate to Finance > Payment Settings in the admin panel.

Webhooks Configuration

Ensure you copy the webhook endpoint from Brilliant Directories into your Stripe dashboard to automate subscription renewals.

Troubleshooting Failed Payments

If a member payment fails, verify your API keys and webhook signing secret.
